description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of promotional products with detailed information

name: DescribeDistributionProducts

parameters.help_en: The number of promotional products per page
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The search label category. Valid values:

code: the commodity code of the promotional product
name: the name of the promotional product
supplierName: the name of the promotion service provider

code：推广商品Code
name：推广商品名称
supplierName：推广服务商名称

code: the product code to search for

supplierName: the supplier name to search for

        APP: application
        SERVICE: service
        CHENGPIN_SITE: ready-made website
        SITE_CUSTOM_SERVICE: custom website
        SITE_PROMOTION_RUN: website promotion and operations
        ENT_APP_SOFT: application software
        CLOUD_SERVICE: cloud service
        EIF: enterprise information

        JIANZHAN_XITONG: website building system

        MIRRORS_MARKET: image marketplace

        DINGDING: DingTalk
        DOWNLOAD: download
        EXTENDED: unknown

        DOCKER: container

        SAAS_WUYING: application software - Wuying application
